text:
Ana: @channel quick heads-up — Lima private VPC / on-prem edge kickoff with partner Centria tomorrow. We need final capacity sign-off and marketplace entitlement gating cleared today. Partners: AndesCloud (hardware), Centria (colocation), SI: AccelOps. :wave:
Marc: Which SKUs + how many GPUs? I checked current quota and we're short on A100 counts in the region.
Sarah: Targeting 4 x EdgeBox-r4 nodes (each 8xA100-sxm) to start, scale to 12 in month 1. Expected 200 qps gen, 1.2M tokens/day initially.
Marc: That aligns — but GCP marketplace listing requires quota approval + private offer SKU mapping. Need GCP project ids and partner marketplace entitlements. Also KMS workflow for customer-managed key.
Kevin: Partner has a draft PO and legal okayed preliminary T&Cs, but finance needs the cost estimate for Dedicated node reservation. Pinged customer for commitment window.
Dave: Legal: we need explicit data residency clause in the private deployment annex. Centria's SOC2 certs are fine but ask for cross-border processing consent in agreement.
Lucia: Centria PM: confirming physical rack availability on 2026-04-18. I'll upload the rack tag and serials to the ticket.
Marc: Filing quota request now — saving the request body for ops:
```
project: redwood-lima-prod
quota: "accelerators/a100-sxm4"
requested: 96
reason: "EdgeBox rollout for partner Centria - initial 32 GPUs, burst to 96"
```
Marc: Ticket #ENG-4521 created with GCP and partner workspace links. @deploy-bot can you run the marketplace entitlement check?
deploy-bot: marketplace-check: ENG-4521 -> Entitlement missing: private-offer mapping for SKU: edgebox-r4. Action: partner must submit private offer ID.
Ana: Can Centria provide the private-offer ID today? Lucia, any ETA?
Lucia: Partner can submit by EOD PST, but marketplace approvals sometimes take 48-72h. They'll also need the KMS key fingerprint to finish mapping.
Kevin: Can we short-circuit with temporary soft-launch on our hosted fleet while marketplace finishes? Need product + sales sign-off.
Sarah: We can do a controlled soft-launch (traffic cap) on hosted for first 48h. But routing policy must ensure VPC-only for regulated tenants.
Dave: Fine with soft-launch, provided we add clause in the customer onboarding doc about fallback regions + data residency.
Marc: Ops blocker: KMS integration required before private VPC go-live. Partner's KMS team needs docs — I'll paste the minimal steps:
```
1) Provide KMS key ARN/fingerprint
2) Partner configure CMK permissions for redwood-service-account
3) Redwood ops map key to project
```
Ana: Ok — plan: Lucia to get private-offer ID + KMS fingerprint by EOD, Marc to submit quota and KMS ticket, Sarah to approve soft-launch config, Kevin to confirm finance PO. If any one misses EOD, we push kickoff 48h. :timer_clock: 
Kevin: Acknowledged — I'll get finance to sign NTE estimate by 1800 PST.
Lucia: Working on it, will update the ticket when submitted.
Marc: Noted. Posting daily status into ENG-4521. Closing thread for now unless blockers pop up. :white_check_mark:
